Call ThunkToFUN00566650(lpSrcStr), processing the source string.
Branch on v6 (the pre-existing slot content): non-null means a list already occupies the slot, null means the slot is free.
When the slot holds a list, walk from v6 following the next pointer at offset 24 (i = *(v6+24); i; i = *(i+24)) to reach the list tail.
Append the new node: write v8 at the tail's next-pointer slot, *(v6+24) = v8.
When the slot was empty, store the node directly at the array slot: this[index] = v8.
Return the converted index (v5) on both successful insertion paths.
